entities.summary: The Chapel of Saint-Louis-de-la-Salpetriere is a Roman Catholic chapel located at 47 Boulevard de l'Hopital in the 13th arrondissement of Paris. It was largely built between 1671 and 1678 as part of a hospital complex started by King Louis XIV in 1656 to provide care for a flood of impoverished people coming into Paris. It was finally completed in 1756.
